sprint_report.goals: This sprint aimed to enhance incident management workflows across multiple systems by streamlining data presentation, improving notification capabilities, and expanding asset management functionality. The team focused on removing unnecessary fields from user views, automating stakeholder communications, and integrating financial data management into parts workflows.
sprint_report.summary: The team completed eight significant improvements to the Service Management platform spanning incident management, asset tracking, and financial operations. Work included refining the incident view interface by removing redundant fields, implementing automated notifications to both ticket submitters and resolution contacts to improve transparency, adding program tracking to hardware records, and establishing a new workflow to automatically populate parts financial data from reference tables. These changes collectively reduce manual data entry, improve communication with end users, enhance asset visibility across the organization, and streamline financial tracking for spare parts management.
